evals.name: feature-verification-dark-mode
evals.prompt: Check if dark mode has been implemented in this codebase. Show me all the relevant files and functions.
evals.expected_output: Analysis should identify whether dark mode is implemented and list relevant files/functions

assertions.name: uses_gemini_cli
assertions.description: Should use gemini -p command for analysis
assertions.check: output includes gemini -p command with @ syntax

assertions.name: targets_relevant_directories
assertions.check: command includes @src/ or similar directory references

evals.name: auth-implementation-check
evals.prompt: Is JWT authentication implemented? List all auth-related endpoints and middleware in the codebase.
evals.expected_output: Should analyze entire codebase to find JWT auth implementation details

assertions.name: analyzes_full_codebase
assertions.description: Should analyze multiple directories for auth implementation
assertions.check: uses @ syntax with multiple directories or @./

evals.name: security-pattern-search
evals.prompt: Search through the entire src/ directory for SQL injection vulnerabilities. Show how user inputs are handled.
evals.expected_output: Should search for SQL injection patterns and show input sanitization

evals.name: architecture-analysis
evals.prompt: Analyze the overall architecture of this project. Show how modules are organized and what patterns are used.
evals.expected_output: Should provide architectural overview of the entire codebase

assertions.name: uses_gemini_for_large_analysis
assertions.description: Should use Gemini CLI for comprehensive analysis

evals.name: test-coverage-verification
evals.prompt: Check if the payment processing module is fully tested. List all test cases and what they cover.
evals.expected_output: Should analyze both source and test directories for payment module

assertions.name: targets_multiple_directories
assertions.description: Should analyze both src and test directories
assertions.check: includes @ with payment/ and tests/ directories
